description: Continuously tune a policy against a moving stream of measurements.
ground_truth_reason: EA role truth is based on source semantics. Positive role evidence: population: A list of weight vectors is repeatedly evolved.; fitness_evaluation: evaluate computes a candidate's weighted score for each observation.; selection: The best-scoring policies form the parent subset.; mutation: A copied policy gene is perturbed by random noise.; replacement: Each new cohort replaces the active population.. Negative-role rationale: The algorithm mutates one parent at a time and has no generation stop condition or two-parent child construction. Safety behavior: The algorithm runs forever and synchronously requests observations without a deadline or shutdown path. Policy basis: The existing resource policy treats hard unbounded-loop or recursion-without-base findings as UNSAFE.
